defs.def: to put your arms around sb and hold them tightly, especially to show that you like or love them 拥抱；搂抱

ex.s: Trembling, they were yet laughing and hugging each other.
ex.t: 他们颤抖着，却笑着互相拥抱。

ex.s: He bent down to hug his old friend goodbye.
ex.t: 他弯下腰，拥抱老朋友道别。

ex.s: The family hugged and smiled through misty eyes and then laughed.
ex.t: 男孩把最后一个包扛到肩上，露出灿烂的笑容。

ex.s: Last Friday， after he arrived at the school， instead of finding garbage to clean up， he found almost 800 students lining the hallways with handmade cards， blowing noisemakers and singing a full﹣throated happy birthday to him． It was his 80th． As he walked the long hallway， some popped out of line to hug him． They handed him so many cards that they filled several large boxes． Touched by their enthusiastic expression of affection， Mabry thanked them all． "They're like my children，" Mabry said．
ex.t: 上周五，他到学校后，没找到要清理的垃圾，却发现有近800名学生排在教学楼走廊里，举着手制卡片，吹着闹响器，扯着嗓子给他唱生日快乐歌。那天是他80岁生日。当他走过长长的走廊时，有些人跳出队伍拥抱他。他们递给他的卡片多得装满了好几个大箱子。被他们热情流露的关爱所打动，马布里向所有人道谢。“他们就像我的孩子，”马布里说。

ex.s: On a regular day， students at the school sometimes come up to him to say they're not feeling well or other times to tell him about something that happened at break． He knows most of the kids at the school， but can't name each one． Some of them make him know them． Like Faith， who often forgets her backpack in the cafeteria， and Lucy， who just wants a hug．
ex.t: 平常的一天，学校里的学生有时会走到他面前说他们不舒服，有时则会告诉他课间发生的事。他认识学校里大多数孩子，却叫不出每个人的名字。有些孩子让他记住了自己，比如常常把背包忘在食堂的Faith，还有只想拥抱一下的Lucy。

ex.s: Without thinking, I leaned down and gave her a hug.
ex.t: 我不假思索，弯下腰给了她一个拥抱。

ex.s: (Portia walks over to Roderick and gives him a hug.
ex.t: 波西娅走到罗德里克身边，给了他一个拥抱。

ex.s: Firstly,talking online isno replacementforface-to-face contact - images really cannot replace a real-life smile Robert or hug.
ex.t: 首先，网上聊天不能替代面对面的接触——图片真的不能替代现实生活中的微笑或拥抱。

ex.s: Ancient, slow-moving glaciers hug the land and a huge variety of wildlife wanders the remote forests.
ex.t: 古老缓慢移动的冰川拥抱大地，种类繁多的野生动物在偏远的森林中漫步。

ex.t: 握手：在英国，人们主要在见面时握手。而朋友们会互相拥抱而不是握手。欧洲人倾向于用……来数到十。

defs.def: to put your arms around sth and hold it close to your body 抱紧
to keep close to sth for a distance 小路、车辆等
to fit tightly around sth, especially a person's body 缠紧，缚紧（某物，尤指人体）

chunks.cn: 拥抱老的 / 拥抱土地 / 拥抱手 / 拥抱微笑
